# ViaPins
> Travel guides with GPS routes for destinations worldwide.

Site: https://viapins.com
Sitemap: https://viapins.com/sitemap.xml
Robots: https://viapins.com/robots.txt

## Primary sections
- Country hubs: /{locale}/explore/{country}
- City guides: /{locale}/explore/{country}/{city}
- Landmarks: /{locale}/explore/{country}/{city}/{place}
- City guide pages: /{locale}/explore/{country}/{city}/guide/{things-to-do|3-day-itinerary|hidden-gems}
- Stays: /{locale}/explore/{country}/{city}/stays
- Adventures: /{locale}/adventures and /{locale}/explore/{country}/adventure
- Search: /{locale}/search?q=

## Locales
en, bg, es, fr, de, it
